title: AP Precalculus 2.4 — Exponential Function Manipulation
question: How do the exponent rules rewrite an exponential function in the form ab^x, and turn a factor over one interval into a factor over another?
intro:
**Quick recap:** Use exponent rules to rewrite exponential functions into equivalent forms:

\[
b^{u+v}=b^ub^v,\qquad
b^{u-v}=\frac{b^u}{b^v},\qquad
(b^u)^v=b^{uv}
\]

**Show your calculation before choosing A–D.**

questions.title: Simplify a shifted exponent
questions.prompt:
Rewrite the following in the form \(f(x)=ab^x\):

\[
f(x)=24\cdot2^{x-3}
\]
questions.solution_title: Separate the subtraction in the exponent

questions.title: Find the multiplication factor per unit
questions.prompt:
Rewrite the following in the form \(g(x)=ab^x\):

\[
g(x)=4\cdot3^{2x+1}
\]
questions.solution_title: Separate the sum, then simplify the power

questions.title: Rewrite a negative exponent
questions.prompt:
Which expression is equivalent to:

\[
h(x)=5\cdot2^{-x}?
\]
questions.solution_title: A negative exponent gives a reciprocal

questions.title: Convert a growth interval into a yearly factor
questions.prompt:
A population follows the model:

\[
P(t)=200\cdot8^{t/3}
\]

Here, \(t\) is measured in years. Which equivalent model shows the **multiplication factor per year**?
questions.solution_title: Take the cube root of the three-year factor

questions.title: Convert daily decay into a two-day percentage
questions.prompt:
A quantity is modeled by:

\[
Q(t)=500(0.8)^t
\]

Here, \(t\) is measured in days. Rewrite the model using \(t/2\) in the exponent and identify the **percentage decrease every two days**.
